units.source_text: 源氏大将进入广漠的旷野，但见景象异常萧条。

en.t: General Genji entered the vast wilderness, where the scene before him looked extraordinarily bleak.
All the autumn flowers had already withered.

units.source_text: 蔓草中的虫声与凄厉的松风声，合成一种不可名状的音调。

en.t: The insects crying among the trailing grasses and the piercing sound of wind in the pines blended into an indescribable tone.

units.source_text: 远处飘来断断续续的音乐声，清艳动人。

en.t: From far away came intermittent strains of music, clear, graceful, and moving.

units.source_text: 大将只用十几个亲信的前驱者，随身侍从也很简单，并不招摇。

en.t: The general used only a dozen or so trusted attendants as his advance party, and his personal retinue was simple and unostentatious.

units.source_text: 大将作微行打扮，然而也很讲究，姿态十分优美。

en.t: The general was dressed for a discreet outing, yet his attire was still refined, and his bearing was exceedingly elegant.

units.source_text: 随伴大将的几个风流人物，都觉得这打扮与这时地非常调和，衷心感动。

en.t: The several men of taste accompanying the general all felt that this dress suited the time and place perfectly, and they were deeply moved.

units.source_text: 源氏大将自己也想：“我以前为什么不常到这种好地方来玩玩呢？”

en.t: General Genji himself also thought, Why did I not come more often before to enjoy such a fine place?
He felt considerable regret for having neglected such beautiful scenery.
